publication_root: required explicit --published-root research/...; source files and launcher must be under same published directory
launch_syntax: launcher.py --launch --self-sha256 SHA --coordinator-sha256 SHA --auditor-sha256 SHA --closer-sha256 SHA --expected-commit COMMIT --published-root research/PATH -- ACTUAL_COORDINATOR_BINDINGS
private_environment: Runtime-only existing private configuration read, same-process os.environ then runpy. No secret argv/receipt/error text. No private configuration was read while preparing this source.
clocks: No time module, experiment clock/deadline, source copying or STATE writes. Actual coordinator must inherit all original LA1 clocks including setup900. Optional preflight identities are actual own/bootstrap PID/create_time only.
worker_policy: Unchanged reviewed supervisor only injects provider credential into primary solver; inherited model-worker blacklist removes API key. No worker runtime modification.
review_boundary: No actual preflight, Git source verification, import, coordinator invocation, tests, fits or API executed. Publication/runtime availability are pending root action.
